dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Most of the crops are growing well and I don't need to till the soil at this time of year. I just need to watch out for weasels coming to steal my vegetables.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: What with my back being the way it is, I can't really exert myself, but luckily, I have my little Tatankasaurs to help out till I'm better.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: Once the pain stops, I'll go help my old pa open up a new field.

dialogues.speaker: Paqarin
dialogues.text: *sigh* He's as stubborn as a mule — he's getting on in years but refuses to accept that. He won't listen to sense.
